scope: Existing state-machine visualization only; surrounding guide content preserved.

design.cards: Rounded HTML cards with equal primary dimensions
design.connectors: SVG paths with proper arrowheads, neutral gray, no animation
design.desktop: Four horizontal normal states, Fault directly below Running, Complete-to-Ready loop above, Fault-to-Idle recovery below.
design.narrow: Vertical normal states with a distinct right-side timeout branch and two separate left-side return paths. Responsive change at 820px avoids crowded transition labels.
design.typography: Existing site family; title 22px, states 18px desktop/17px narrow, descriptions 13px, transitions 12px, note 12px.
design.accessibility: Selectable HTML labels and descriptions. SVG connectors decorative; state-to-state transition names exposed as screen-reader text. Hidden alternate layout excluded from accessibility tree by display:none.

behavior: Fault recovery returns to Idle. Ready and a new start request are still required before Running.
explanation: Exact supplied explanation and technical note below the diagram.

validation.visualReview: Passed desktop (1587 CSS px), tablet (767 px) and narrow mobile (288 px). No card overflow, label/card collisions or page scrolling horizontally.
